hero.caption: The last will and messages of James M Kim, a British Chinese member of the Hong Kong Defence Forces at Stanley Civil Internment Camp, Hong Kong inscribed on his cell wall as a record. - the reason for his execution is unknown. Note that owing to efforts made by the Japanese to erase these messages parts of them are indecipherable.
